summary: Reduce repeated planner, verification, maintenance, release, and publication overhead with bounded execution windows and evidence-triggered review while preserving canonical batch verification.

candidates.rationale: Batch compatible task work behind cheap checkpoints, measure unusually slow sessions from observable evidence, trigger interaction maintenance only when useful, and separate local development/sealing from explicit remote publication.

applied_changes.description: Added planner execution windows/lazy task access, slow-run efficiency review, interaction maintenance triggers, explicit-user publication policy, optional local sealing, conditional-continuation rule, development metadata, and focused regression coverage.
